entries.title: Infliction
entries.definitive_edition: Infliction: Extended Cut on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the current PC build; no console emulation route is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with Extended Cut content.

primary.why: The Windows PC Extended Cut route is the best version because the PC release was upgraded to Extended Cut, giving it the added content from the console release while keeping PC capture/settings flexibility.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Infliction on Steam or Infliction: Extended Cut on GOG and play the current Windows PC build. Verify it is updated to the Extended Cut content before starting.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release, upgraded to Extended Cut in 2020 with PC settings and capture flexibility.
all_releases.reason: primary: complete Extended Cut content on the highest-flexibility platform.
skip: the Extended Cut content exists on PC as well, so no separate platform-exclusive route is needed.
skip: useful handheld route, but no sourced exclusive content over the PC Extended Cut.

all_releases.fidelity: Limited Run physical PS5 Extended Cut release.
all_releases.reason: skip: collectible physical route, but no sourced exclusive content over the PC Extended Cut.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The Extended Cut content was brought to PC, so the PC route is both the complete and highest-flexibility route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Extended Cut is a content expansion/update, not a separate visual remaster; ensure the PC build is updated.
